notes.bogner-hall: Bogner Hall (#3 on Molloy's 2024 campus map, molloy.edu/_documents/admission-aid/3d-rendered-campus-map-2024.pdf) isn't in OSM: it stands on what OSM still maps as a surface car park (way/608163171), west of Maria Regina Hall and south of Fitzgerald Hall. Pinned on the building's centre in Esri World Imagery (2026-11-27), which matches OSM's Fitzgerald outline to about 5 m.
notes.kellenberg-hall: Molloy's dining hall, the Anselma Room, is on Kellenberg Hall's first floor, and the James E. Tobin Library on its second (molloy.edu/academics/resources/library/about). A place has one kind, so it is the dining hall; the name still matches classes there.
notes.quealy-hall: Quealy Hall is the gymnasium ("Quealy Hall (Gymnasium)", #14 on Molloy's 2024 campus map).
